app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Google Chat** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message:
使用已設定連線的驗證向 **Google Chat** 發起自訂 HTTP / REST API 呼叫。

指定 HTTP 方法、URI 路徑（相對於連線的 API 基本 URL）、選擇性查詢參數、標頭和請求主體。回應會以包含狀態碼、回應標頭和回應主體的雜湊傳回。

對於此應用程式上尚未公開為一級動作的端點，請使用此動作。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 請求主體。有效類型取決於 `body_type`：JSON/表單/YAML 預期為雜湊，XML/文字預期為字串，multipart 預期為檔案結構，二進位預期為原始位元組。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 使用 `multipart/form-data` 上傳檔案。主體必須是 @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" 結構 (filename + content + mime_type)。框架會建立 multipart 信封並設定 boundary 標頭。
使用 multipart/form-data 上傳檔案

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Pass the body to the REST client unchanged; the client decides serialization based on its configured `data` option and the value type
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 將主體原封不動地傳遞給 REST 用戶端；用戶端會根據其設定的 `data` 選項與數值類型來決定序列化方式

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Pass-through; use connection serialization and let the REST client decide
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 透傳；使用連線序列化並由 REST 用戶端決定

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 將主體作為原始位元組傳送。主體必須是二進位值。除非被 `hdr` 覆寫，否則會設定 `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。
將主體作為原始位元組傳送

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 將表單欄位的雜湊序列化為 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`。主體必須是值為純量 (字串/數字/布林值) 的雜湊。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Serialize body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 將主體序列化為 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表單欄位

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 將主體序列化為 JSON；設定 `Content-Type: application/json`。主體應為雜湊、清單或純量值。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 將主體作為純文字傳送。主體必須是字串。設定 `Content-Type: text/plain`。
將主體作為 text/plain 傳送

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 將主體作為 XML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 XML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/xml`。
將主體作為 XML 傳送

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 將主體作為 YAML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 YAML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`。
將主體作為 YAML 傳送

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Selects the body serialization mode and the corresponding `Content-Type` header. Changing this field reshapes the `body` editor - selecting JSON exposes a JSON editor, selecting Multipart Form exposes a file picker, and so on.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 選擇主體序列化模式與相應的 `Content-Type` 標頭。變更此欄位會重塑 `body` 編輯器 - 選擇 JSON 會顯示 JSON 編輯器，選擇 Multipart Form 會顯示檔案選擇器，依此類推。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: How the body is serialized and what Content-Type is sent
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 主體如何序列化以及傳送何種 Content-Type

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: If `True`, non-2xx HTTP responses return as the normal response hash (with the actual status code) instead of raising `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`. Useful for handling 4xx/5xx as data - e.g. checking whether a resource exists. Overrides the connection's `error_passthru` setting for this call only.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 若為 `True`，非 2xx 的 HTTP 回應將作為正常的回應雜湊 (包含實際狀態碼) 返回，而不是引發 `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`。適用於將 4xx/5xx 作為資料處理 - 例如檢查資源是否存在。僅針對本次呼叫覆寫連線的 `error_passthru` 設定。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Return non-2xx responses normally instead of throwing
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 正常返回非 2xx 回應，而不是拋出例外

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Optional list of HTTP status codes treated as success. If set and the response status is not in this list, the action throws `REST-STATUS-ERROR`. When unset, the REST client's default behavior applies (typically: 2xx is success, non-2xx throws).
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 視為成功的選擇性 HTTP 狀態碼清單。若已設定且回應狀態不在此清單中，該動作將拋出 `REST-STATUS-ERROR`。未設定時，套用 REST 用戶端的預設行為 (通常：2xx 代表成功，非 2xx 拋出例外)。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Response status codes treated as success
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 視為成功的回應狀態碼

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Hash of custom headers added to the request. These override any default headers set by `body_type` (e.g. supplying `Content-Type` here wins over the body-type default).
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 新增至請求的自訂標頭雜湊。這些會覆寫由 `body_type` 設定的任何預設標頭 (例如：在此處提供 `Content-Type` 會優先於主體類型的預設值)。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: If `True`, the response hash includes a `debug` sub-hash containing the request method/URL/headers (with sensitive values redacted), request and response sizes, and round-trip duration. Useful when investigating slow or failing calls. Off by default to keep responses lean.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 若為 `True`，回應雜湊包含一個 `debug` 子雜湊，其中包含請求方法/URL/標頭 (敏感值已遮蔽)、請求與回應大小以及來回時間。在調查過慢或失敗的呼叫時很有用。預設關閉以維持回應精簡。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Include request/timing/size debug info in the response
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 在回應中包含請求/時序/大小除錯資訊

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL. May contain `{name}` placeholders that are replaced from `path_vars`. Example: `/users/{id}/comments`.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 相於連線 API 基本 URL 的 URI 路徑。可能包含從 `path_vars` 替換的 `{name}` 預留位置。範例：`/users/{id}/comments`。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 替換至 URI 路徑中 `{name}` 預留位置的值 Hash。範例：使用 `path = /users/{id}` 與 `path_vars = {id: 123}` 時，框架會傳送 `/users/123`。數值均經過 URL 編碼。
路徑中 {name} 預留位置的值

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Hash of query string parameters to append to the URI path. Values are URL-encoded; list values are joined with `,`.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 要附加至 URI 路徑的查詢字串參數 Hash。數值均經過 URL 編碼；清單值會使用 `,` 連接。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.source: Make a custom API call to Google Chat
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2.message: 向 Google Chat 發起自訂 API 呼叫

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bmV3X21lc3NhZ2.source: Select the Google Chat space where you want to monitor for new messages. The trigger will fire whenever a new message is posted in this space.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bmV3X21lc3NhZ2.message: 選擇您想要監控新訊息的 Google Chat 專區。每當在此專區發布新訊息時，即會觸發此觸發條件。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bmV3X21lc3NhZ2.source: The Google Chat space to monitor for new messages
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.bmV3X21lc3NhZ2.message: 要監控新訊息的 Google Chat 專區

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.c2VuZF9tZXNzYW.source: The ID of an existing message to reply to or update. Leave empty to send a new message.
app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.c2VuZF9tZXNzYW.message: 要回覆或更新的現有訊息 ID。留空則傳送新訊息。

app.R29vZ2xlQ2hhdA.action.c2VuZF9tZXNzYW.source: ID for message replies or updates
